## A complete example

Compare `0O`, `1Il`, `{}[]()`, and `=> != <=`. The font, line spacing, and
syntax colors all contribute to a readable block.

```{.python filename="library.py"}
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Book:
    title: str
    author: str
    year: int

def find_books(books: list[Book], query: str) -> list[Book]:
    """Find a title or author, ignoring case."""
    needle = query.casefold()
    return [book for book in books if needle in book.title.casefold()]

books = [Book("A Room with a View", "E. M. Forster", 1908)]
print(find_books(books, "room"))
```

## More than one language

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Python

```python
titles = sorted(book.title for book in books if book.year < 1920)
```

### JavaScript

```javascript
const titles = books.filter(book => book.year < 1920)
  .map(book => book.title).sort();
```

### SQL

```sql
SELECT title, author FROM books WHERE year < 1920 ORDER BY title;
```

:::
